say:1:1910506001:1.text: When you all left Coralia, Grandma's heart left with you. She stood by my window the whole time checking when you'd be back.
say:1:1910506001:1.source_cn: 你们游出塔拉萨的时候，阿嬷的心也跟着你们飘走了，她一直...

say:2:1910506002:1.text: Don't worry, Grandma. We didn't lose any of our tentacles.
say:2:1910506002:1.source_cn: 放心吧，阿嬷，我们一根触须都没少！

say:3:1910506003:1.text: As long as you're all okay... Let me see your hands.
say:3:1910506003:1.source_cn: 一切平安就好，一切平安就好……把你们的手给我。

say:4:1910506004:1.text: Menoa places a transparent, glowing insect into the palm of each of your hands.
say:4:1910506004:1.source_cn: 摩淖亚在你们每人掌心放下一只散发着淡淡光芒的透明浮虫。
say:4:1910506004:1.male: Menoa places a transparent, glowing insect into the palm of each of your hands.
say:4:1910506004:1.female: Menoa places a transparent, glowing insect into the palm of each of your hands.

say:10:1910506008:1.text: It is a ritual that honors the ocean currents and gives thanks for everyone's safe return. Crush the insect, let it drift away on the current, and the sea will receive your gratitude.
say:10:1910506008:1.source_cn: 向洋流祈祷，感谢你们平安回来的仪式嘛！把这种浮虫捏碎，...

say:11:1910506009:1.text: Whether or not you went through the sacred immersion of the Cradle Pool, you are all children of the Seamoon Clan. We're so glad you returned safely.
say:11:1910506009:1.source_cn: 不管有没有经过繁育池的神圣浸没，你们都是海月家的孩子。...

say:12:1910506010:1.text: I crushed mine! Oh currents and tides, we thank you for your protection.
say:12:1910506010:1.source_cn: 我捏碎啦！洋流啊洋流，我们感谢你的保佑。

say:13:1910506011:1.text: Ugh... my hand is sticky now...

choice_prompt:14:1910506011.text: Ugh... my hand is sticky now...

say:15:1910506012:3.text: Elphira, did you notice anything unusual on your way back? The Tidewarden dove deep into the depths. That's never happened before...
say:15:1910506012:3.source_cn: 艾菲拉，你们回来的时候，有看到异常状况吗？波涛长者突然...

say:16:1910506013:1.text: The madness afflicting the Deepfolk, the eerie way the affliction manifested in Garnet, and the sounds that Elphira has heard...
say:16:1910506013:1.source_cn: 深海裔的疯症，歌尼特诡异的发病状态，以及艾菲拉听到的“...
say:16:1910506013:1.male: The madness afflicting the Deepfolk, the eerie way the affliction manifested in Garnet, and the sounds that Elphira has heard...
say:16:1910506013:1.female: The madness afflicting the Deepfolk, the eerie way the affliction manifested in Garnet, and the sounds that Elphira has heard...

say:17:1910506014:1.text: There are too many anomalies to explain all at once. You don't know where to begin. After a long explanation, you finally help Menoa and Morin understand what's going on.
say:17:1910506014:1.source_cn: 异常状况实在太多，你们一时间竟然不知道该从何说起。好一...
say:17:1910506014:1.male: There are too many anomalies to explain all at once. You don't know where to begin. After a long explanation, you finally help Menoa and Morin understand what's going on.
say:17:1910506014:1.female: There are too many anomalies to explain all at once. You don't know where to begin. After a long explanation, you finally help Menoa and Morin understand what's going on.

say:18:1910506015:1.text: H-how could something like this happen?!
say:18:1910506015:1.source_cn: 怎么……怎么会出现这种事？！

say:19:1910506016:1.text: Grandma, have you ever heard of something like this? What's Elphira hearing? Will something happen to her? W-what should we do?
say:19:1910506016:1.source_cn: 阿嬷，你听说过那种声音吗？艾菲拉为什么会听到它，她会不...

say:20:1910506017:1.text: Children, by your description, if Elphira is truly affected, then others in Coralia should be showing similar symptoms.
say:20:1910506017:1.source_cn: 孩子们，按照你们的描述，如果小浪花真的受到影响，塔拉萨...

say:21:1910506018:1.text: However, let's not panic. We should go around and ask how everyone is doing.
say:21:1910506018:1.source_cn: 先不要惊慌，我们去问问大家的情况。

choice_prompt:22:1910506018.text: However, let's not panic. We should go around and ask how everyone is doing.
choice_prompt:22:1910506018.source_cn: 先不要惊慌，我们去问问大家的情况。

say:23:1910506021:1.text: Mister Calix said that the Deepfolk don't immediately develop problems the moment they hear the sound. It takes time. As the sounds grow more frequent, they lose their sanity.
say:23:1910506021:1.source_cn: 卡律先生说，深海裔并不是听到声音，就立刻出现问题的。是...

say:24:1910506022:1.text: Are you worried that the madness has already spread to Coralia and that it's simply lying dormant?
say:24:1910506022:1.source_cn: 孩子们，你们担心疯症可能已经在塔拉萨蔓延，只是还在潜伏期？

choice_prompt:25:1910506022.text: Are you worried that the madness has already spread to Coralia and that it's simply lying dormant?
choice_prompt:25:1910506022.source_cn: 孩子们，你们担心疯症可能已经在塔拉萨蔓延，只是还在潜伏期？

say:26:1910506023:1.text: We can't take this lightly. We need to get to the bottom of it as soon as possible.
say:26:1910506023:1.source_cn: 不能掉以轻心，得尽快搞清楚这件事。

say:27:1910506024:1.text: Let's head to the western part of the city and take a look.

choice_prompt:28:1910506024.text: Let's head to the western part of the city and take a look.

say:29:1910506025:1.text: Alright, I'll go ask around as well!

choice:28:0:1.text: We can split up and meet back here later.
choice:28:0:1.source_cn: 分头行动，之后在这里汇合
choice:28:0:1.male: We can split up and meet back here later.
choice:28:0:1.female: We can split up and meet back here later.

choice:28:1:2.text: I can check the north and south sides of the city.
choice:28:1:2.male: I can check the north and south sides of the city.
choice:28:1:2.female: I can check the north and south sides of the city.

choice:22:0:1.text: This really needs to be looked into.
choice:22:0:1.male: This really needs to be looked into.
choice:22:0:1.female: This really needs to be looked into.

say:31:1910506019:3.text: Then why didn't either of us hear this sound?
say:31:1910506019:3.source_cn: 那咱俩为啥没听见那个“声音”？

choice:22:1:2.text: Perhaps this madness is from contact with the Deepfolk.
choice:22:1:2.source_cn: 也许接触深海裔才会染上疯症
choice:22:1:2.male: Perhaps this madness is from contact with the Deepfolk.
choice:22:1:2.female: Perhaps this madness is from contact with the Deepfolk.

say:32:1910506020:3.text: Yeah, that makes sense. We didn't hear a thing.
say:32:1910506020:3.source_cn: 啧，有道理，咱俩可啥都没听见！

choice:22:2:3.text: Maybe only the Merfolk are affected.
choice:22:2:3.source_cn: 难道只有海裔才会受到影响？
choice:22:2:3.male: Maybe only the Merfolk are affected.
choice:22:2:3.female: Maybe only the Merfolk are affected.

choice:9:0:1.text: Do I have to do it too?
choice:9:0:1.male: Do I have to do it too?
choice:9:0:1.female: Do I have to do it too?

choice:9:1:2.text: Ah! It's crawling around my hand!
choice:9:1:2.source_cn: 它在爬它在我手里爬，救命！！
choice:9:1:2.male: Ah! It's crawling around my hand!
choice:9:1:2.female: Ah! It's crawling around my hand!

choice:9:2:3.text: Hmm... is this a Merfolk ritual?
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: （对神秘的海裔仪式感到好奇）
choice:9:2:3.male: Hmm... is this a Merfolk ritual?
choice:9:2:3.female: Hmm... is this a Merfolk ritual?
